business_summary: HeNan Splendor Science & Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development and promotion of automated measurement and control technologies for the rail transit industry in China and internationally. The company offers centralized signals, railway natural disaster and foreign object and railway perimeter intrusion, railway earthquake warning, ZPW-2000 inter-section track circuit outdoor, railway communication power supply and computer room environment, turnout gap, and railway signal cable, railway flood control intelligent, wireless shunting locomotive signaling, train automatic, and railway contact line icing and galloping monitoring systems. It also provides electric heating turnout snow melting system equipment, railway integrated video surveillance, automatic monitoring and alarm, and intelligent inspection management systems; contact line insulator water washing trucks, subway tunnel cleaning vehicles, power grid big data intelligent operation and maintenance platform, railway signal axle counting equipment, computer interlocking, railway signal power supply panel, railway turnout switch machines, and signal monitoring lightning protection distribution cabinets; and railway transportation integrated management information, CTC, train operation dispatching command, railway network security protection, intelligent video analysis, railway unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent inspection, and overhead contact line safety intelligent analysis systems. In addition, the company offers urban rail transit integrated monitoring, automatic fare collection, closed-circuit television surveillance, urban rail integrated support platform, urban rail transit signal maintenance support and intelligent operation and maintenance, urban rail energy management, environmental and equipment, wind and water linkage energy saving control, security integration platform, and network command center systems. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Zhengzhou, China.
